clips.title: The story
paras: In Lakeshire, Magistrate Solomon sends an urgent appeal to Westfall for help against Blackrock orcs and gnolls. He asks Gryan Stoutmantle to send the People's Militia while Stormwind's royal army fails to answer.

Blackrock orcs and hostile gnolls threaten Redridge, and Magistrate Solomon is isolated in Lakeshire. Stormwind's royal army has not arrived in force to defend the region's borders. With no time to wait for support from the capital, Solomon writes to seek help beyond the regular army. Word has reached him of a volunteer defense force forming in Elwynn to the west, so he appeals to the People's Militia.

Solomon addresses his message to Gryan Stoutmantle, a veteran warrior organizing Westfall's frontier defense. He hopes Stoutmantle can spare fighters for Lakeshire until Stormwind sends regular reserves. An adventurer carries the document. With Stormwind's outlying territories poorly coordinated, local magistrates must arrange mutual aid on their own.
